name: Marquee
description: A festival site that is its own poster: the name at poster size whose letters stretch with the cursor, a halftone field, every photo in two inks, a lineup like a bill, days stacked like flyers and passes as ticket stubs, with calm, complete practical pages.

options.label: Three
options.description: Three days in the lineup, the timetable and the passes.

options.label: One
options.description: One day: one timetable, no day passes.

options.label: Four or more
options.description: A day each in the lineup and timetable.

options.label: A ticketing site
options.description: Each pass links to where it is sold.

options.label: Free, with sign-up
options.description: The passes become a free registration form.

options.label: Free, no tickets
options.description: The tickets page goes; the info page says entry is free.
